journal_lines: The shaft went deeper than it should have. Came back with mud on the paws and something extra.
Someone else's tunnel. Old supports, old cart tracks. Fresh ore behind the rot.
Mineshaft, abandoned. The tools were still there. The ore was still there too.
A cart on the tracks, still loaded. The wood had given up but the ore had not.
Old shaft, fresh ore. They had stopped just short. Did not stop short.
Found a lantern on a hook. Empty. Lit my own.
Followed the rails until they ran out, then followed the dust they had left.
Cobwebs thick as wool over the entrance. Brushed them aside gently. They had earned them.
